IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'advw')
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE [advw];
END;
GO

USE [advw];
GO

-- Customer
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Customer] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Customer];
GO

-- Product
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Dim_Product] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'product/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Product];
GO

GO

-- Product SubCategory

GO

    BULK 'calender/',

-- Returns
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Fact_Returns] AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'returns/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [Returns];
GO

-- Unified Sales Fact View (Combines 2015, 2016, 2017)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [gold].[Fact_Sales] AS
SELECT *, 2015 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2015/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S15]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2016 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2016/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S16]
UNION ALL
SELECT *, 2017 AS SalesYear FROM OPENROWSET(BULK 'sales2017/', DATA_SOURCE = 'SilverData', FORMAT = 'PARQUET') AS [S17];
GO

-- 1. Ensure Database Context is advw
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'advw')
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE [advw];
END;
GO

USE [advw];
GO

-- ==================================================
-- External Tables Creation (Gold Layer using CETAS)
-- ==================================================

-- 1. Customer
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('[gold].[ExtCustomer]'))
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE [gold].[ExtCustomer];
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [gold].[ExtCustomer]
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GoldData,
    FILE_FORMAT = [parquet_format]
)
AS 
SELECT * FROM [gold].[Dim_Customer];
GO
